gloss: day and night; morning and evening; all day long

definitions.gloss: day and night; morning and evening; all day long
definitions.explanation: Expresses the idea of doing something continuously from dawn to dusk, emphasizing constant, tireless activity without rest.

definitions.gloss: to be absorbed in; to spend all one's time doing
definitions.explanation: Used with に to indicate what one is absorbed in.

examples.japanese: {明|あ}け{暮|く}れ⟦{勉強|べんきょう}している→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧。
{明|あ}け{暮|く}れ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{追|お}われている→追う：02016_ou⟧。
examples.english: I'm chased by work from morning to night.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{明|あ}け{暮|く}れ⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{励|はげ}んでいた→励む：11822_hagemu⟧。
examples.english: He devoted himself to practice day in and day out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{読書|どくしょ}→読書：03484_dokusho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{明|あ}け{暮|く}れる。
examples.english: To be absorbed in reading all the time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{明|あ}け{暮|く}れた⟦{日々|ひび}→日々：04804_hibi⟧だった。
examples.english: Those were days spent completely absorbed in research.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}い{頃|ころ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{遊|あそ}び→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{明|あ}け{暮|く}れて⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: When I was young, I spent all my time having fun.

notes:
Combines ⟦{明|あ}け→明け：13157_ake⟧ (dawn) and ⟦{暮|く}れ→暮れ：02671_kure⟧ (dusk) to mean "from dawn to dusk" or "all day long." As an adverb (sense 1), it modifies verbs to indicate constant, tireless activity. As a verb with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (sense 2), it takes the pattern ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{明|あ}け{暮|く}れる to mean being completely absorbed in something.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {明|あ}け{暮|く}れ + verb: to do something all day long
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{明|あ}け{暮|く}れる: to be absorbed in; to spend all one's time on

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{明|あ}け{暮|く}れる: to be consumed by work
- ⟦{勉強|べんきょう}→勉強：00770_benkyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{明|あ}け{暮|く}れる: to study constantly
- ⟦{遊|あそ}び→遊び：01285_asobi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{明|あ}け{暮|く}れる: to do nothing but have fun

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{日夜|にちや}→日夜：03130_nichiya⟧: day and night — more formal; often used in written language
- ⟦{昼夜|ちゅうや}→昼夜：12993_chuuya⟧: day and night — similar to ⟦{日夜|にちや}→日夜：03130_nichiya⟧; more neutral
